graffiti.sentenceEn: The UK's Paul Curtis, better known as Moose, operates around Leeds and London and has been commissioned by a number of companies to make reverse graffiti advertisements.
graffiti.translationZh: 英国艺术家保罗·柯蒂斯（更广为人知的名字是“穆斯”）活跃于利兹和伦敦地区，他已受多家公司委托创作反向涂鸦广告。
graffiti.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

graffiti.sentenceEn: The anti-pollution message of the reverse graffiti artists confuses city authorities since the main argument against graffiti is that it spoils the appearance of both types of property: public and private.
graffiti.translationZh: 这些反向涂鸦艺术家传递的反污染信息让市政当局感到困惑，因为反对涂鸦的主要理由是它会破坏公共和私人两类财产的外观。
graffiti.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

graffiti.sentenceEn: A number of street artists around the world have started expressing themselves through a practice known as reverse graffiti (涂鸦).
graffiti.translationZh: 世界上有许多街头艺术家开始通过一种被称为“反向涂鸦”的手法来表达自己。
graffiti.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

graffiti.sentenceEn: Now known as "New York's shared space for art and play," the island, which lies between Manhattan and Brooklyn in Upper New York Bay, is closed to cars but open to summer tourists who flock for festivals, picnics, adventures, as well as these "legal graffiti (涂鸦)" sessions.
graffiti.translationZh: 如今，这座位于上纽约湾、地处曼哈顿与布鲁克林之间的岛屿被誉为"纽约艺术与休闲共享空间"。该岛禁止机动车通行，但对夏季游客开放，他们纷纷前来参加节庆活动、野餐、探险，以及这些"合法涂鸦"活动。
graffiti.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

graffiti.sentenceEn: What do reverse graffiti artists try to do?
graffiti.translationZh: 反向涂鸦艺术家试图做什么？

graffiti.sentenceEn: He chose tunnels to do his graffiti art.
graffiti.translationZh: 他选择隧道进行他的涂鸦艺术创作。

guarantee.sentenceEn: The second is guaranteed to look great for about 10 years, whereas the cheaper one will start to dull after around six or seven years.
guarantee.translationZh: 贵的那款保证十年内都能保持美观，而便宜的那款大概六七年后就会开始褪色。
guarantee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

guarantee.sentenceEn: And even if I get a promotion, I'm not guaranteed to get a raise.
guarantee.translationZh: 而且就算我升职了，也未必能加薪。
guarantee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

guarantee.sentenceEn: If breakfast alone isn't a guarantee of weight loss, why is there a link between obesity and breakfast-skipping?
guarantee.translationZh: 如果单靠早餐并不能保证减肥，那么为什么肥胖和不吃早餐之间会存在关联呢？

guarantee.sentenceEn: "I don't know whether I had my hands on the steering wheel or not. I am not the most flexible person in the world, but I can guarantee my knees were up next to my ears."
guarantee.translationZh: 我都不知道自己的手还在不在方向盘上。我本来就不是什么柔韧性好的人，但当时我的膝盖绝对都快顶到耳朵了。
guarantee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

guarantee.sentenceEn: Acquisition of new knowledge may not guarantee the progress that you aim to make.
guarantee.translationZh: 获取新知识未必能保证你所期望的进步。

guarantee.sentenceEn: It is a guarantee for real success in life.
guarantee.translationZh: 这是人生真正成功的保证。

guy.sentenceEn: He added: "The broader sport is a little too inward-looking, and we need to be more open. In some ways, I'm glad to be coming from the outside. The guys who are in the sport forever are sitting there saying: 'We can't do that. We can't do that because it's never been done that way.'"
guy.translationZh: 他补充道："这项运动整体上有些过于内向，我们需要更加开放。在某些方面，我很高兴能以外部人的身份加入。那些在这项运动中待了一辈子的人总是说：'我们不能那样做。我们不能那样做，因为从来没有人那样做过。'"

guy.sentenceEn: They would run around looking for clues and at the end unmask the bad guy .
guy.translationZh: 他们会四处奔跑寻找线索，最后揭开坏人的面具。

guy.sentenceEn: Owner Guy Wilson says his café aims to build community, rather than profits.
guy.translationZh: 店主盖伊·威尔逊表示，他的咖啡馆旨在建立社区联结，而非追求利润。
guy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

guy.sentenceEn: He's a lovely guy , and he'll be happy to help.
guy.translationZh: 他是个非常好的人，会很乐意帮忙的。

guy.sentenceEn: What happens when people start to know each other according to Guy Wilson?
guy.translationZh: 根据盖伊·威尔逊的说法，当人们开始相互了解时会发生什么？

garbage.sentenceEn: Police said a 64-year-old man found the paintings in a garbage pile at a highway rest stop last month.
garbage.translationZh: 警方称，一名64岁男子上月在高速公路休息站的垃圾堆中发现了这两幅画。

garbage.sentenceEn: In the show, Marie Kondo acts as a tiny garbage fairy for messy people, visiting their houses to share the wisdom of the "KonMari" method.
garbage.translationZh: 在节目中，近藤典子就像是一位专门为生活杂乱者服务的整理精灵，她走访这些人的家，分享"近藤式整理法"的智慧。
garbage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

garbage.sentenceEn: Even garbage attracts ants, so empty your trash as often as possible, and store your outside garbage in a lidded can, well away from doors and windows.
garbage.translationZh: 即便是垃圾也会吸引蚂蚁，因此要尽可能经常倒垃圾，并且将室外垃圾存放在带盖的垃圾桶中，放置在远离门窗的地方。
garbage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第15句

garbage.sentenceEn: But how much garbage exactly have humans left on the moon?

garbage.translationZh: 这会产生大量的电子垃圾。

giant.translationZh: 亚马逊河豚是其物种中的巨人。

giant.sentenceEn: They were such strange marvels that, on her first official state visit to the United States in 1957, Queen Elizabeth II insisted on an impromptu(即兴的) tour of a suburban-Maryland Giant Food.
giant.translationZh: 超市在当时简直是不可思议的奇迹，以至于1957年伊丽莎白二世女王首次对美国进行正式国事访问时，还坚持要即兴参观马里兰州郊区的一家巨人食品超市。
giant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

giant.sentenceEn: For more than a decade, they have been under attack from e-commerce giants , blamed for making Americans fat, and accused of contributing to climate change.
giant.translationZh: 十多年来，超市一直受到电商巨头的冲击，被指责导致美国人肥胖，还被指控加剧了气候变化。
giant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

giant.sentenceEn: "It is hopeless to report fake villa websites to the internet giants who host them," he says.
giant.translationZh: 他说：“向托管这些虚假别墅网站的互联网巨头举报是徒劳的。”

girlfriend.sentenceEn: If Johnny's girlfriend doesn't like him for who he is, then she does not deserve to be his girlfriend .
girlfriend.translationZh: 如果约翰尼的女朋友不喜欢真实的他，那她就不配做他的女朋友。
girlfriend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第16段，第3句
文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

girlfriend.sentenceEn: Veiseh can even put a date on when those tapes started recording: 15 December 2000, when he met his first girlfriend at his best friend's 16th birthday party.
girlfriend.translationZh: 韦瑟甚至能准确说出这些录像带开始录制的日期：2000年12月15日，那天他在挚友的16岁生日派对上邂逅了自己的初恋女友。

girlfriend.sentenceEn: How could we describe the speakers' attitude towards Johnny's girlfriend ?
girlfriend.translationZh: 我们该如何描述说话者对约翰尼女友的态度？

girlfriend.sentenceEn: He has just quarreled with his girlfriend .
girlfriend.translationZh: 他刚刚和他女朋友吵架了。

grader.sentenceEn: One study of ninth-grade students found that 50 percent of friendships among ninth graders changed from one month to the next, signaling striking instability in friendships.
grader.translationZh: 一项针对九年级学生的研究发现，50%的九年级友谊在一个月内就会发生变化，这表明友谊存在显著的不稳定性。

grader.sentenceEn: The EdX assessment tool requires human teachers, or graders , to first grade 100 essays or essay questions.
grader.translationZh: EdX的评分工具要求人类教师或评分员首先对100篇作文或作文题进行评分。

grader.sentenceEn: The challenge is that this requires human graders , and so they cost a lot more and they take a lot more time.
grader.translationZh: 但问题在于这需要人工评分，因此成本更高，耗时也更长。

grader.sentenceEn: He has also been highly critical of studies claiming that the software compares well to human graders .
grader.translationZh: 他还对那些声称该软件评分效果堪比人工评分的研究提出了强烈批评。

grader.sentenceEn: In some cases the software is used as a "second reader," to check the reliability of the human graders .
grader.translationZh: 在某些情况下，该软件被用作"二次阅卷者"，以检查人工阅卷的可靠性。

grader.sentenceEn: Participation of ninth graders in Design Ventura can motivate them to choose design technology as their subject.
grader.translationZh: 九年级学生参与“设计先锋”项目能够激励他们选择设计技术作为自己的学科。

genius.sentenceEn: In a research paper, Evil Genius , published in 2014, the behavioral scientists Francesca Gino and Scott Wiltermuth wanted to examine whether people who behave unethically in one task are more creative than others on a subsequent task, even after controlling for differences in baseline creative skills.
genius.translationZh: 行为科学家弗朗西斯卡·吉诺(Francesca Gino)和斯科特·威尔特穆思(Scott Wiltermuth)在2014年发表了一篇题为《邪恶天才》(Evil Genius)的研究论文，旨在探讨在某项任务中行为不道德的人，在后续任务中的创造力是否比其他人更强，即使在控制了基线创造力技能的差异后也是如此。

genius.sentenceEn: For example, you might recognize that you are intelligent, but realize that you are not a genius .
genius.translationZh: 例如，你可能承认自己很聪明，但也明白自己并非天才。
genius.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

genius.sentenceEn: You might as well call it the Year of the Lunch Box, thanks in large part to a genius move by a Nashville-based manufacturer, Aladdin Industries.
genius.translationZh: 你甚至可以称1950年为'午餐盒之年'，这在很大程度上要归功于纳什维尔一家制造商——阿拉丁工业公司的天才之举。

genius.sentenceEn: Also, I have a good chance of winning a scholarship at Leeds, which would be pretty awesome, the benefits of being a music genius .
genius.translationZh: 而且，我很有机会在利兹大学获得奖学金，那简直太棒了，这就是作为音乐天才的好处。
genius.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

genius.sentenceEn: Franklin, who was largely self-taught, may have been a genius , but he wasn't really an exception when it comes to American making and creativity.
genius.translationZh: 富兰克林虽然主要靠自学成才，或许算得上是个天才，但在美国人的创造与创新精神中，他并非一个真正的例外。

genius.sentenceEn: Research is converging(汇聚) on the conclusion that great accomplishment and even genius are typically the result of years of passion and dedication and not something that flows naturally from a gift.
genius.translationZh: 多项研究正逐渐得出一致结论：卓越成就乃至天才通常是多年热情投入与不懈努力的结果，而非天赋自然流露的产物。

gratitude.sentenceEn: The social experiment showed that 99 out of 100 people expressed gratitude .
gratitude.translationZh: 这项社会实验显示，100人中有99人表达了感谢。
gratitude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

gratitude.sentenceEn: The waiter, who's working his way through school, did accept the customer's apology and gratitude and said he was happy to have helped her.
gratitude.translationZh: 这位正在勤工俭学的服务员确实接受了顾客的道歉和感谢，并表示很高兴能帮到她。
gratitude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

gratitude.sentenceEn: "A simple way to induce gratitude in people is opening doors and so we went to six places and opened the doors for people."
gratitude.translationZh: “一个简单的引发人们感恩之心的方式就是为他人开门，因此我们去了六个地方为人们开门。”
gratitude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

gratitude.sentenceEn: "I didn't think we were going to get 99. I don't know why, but I was pleasantly surprised because it went beyond just 'thank you.' People got into conversations with us," said Steve Foran, CEO of Gratitude at Work.
gratitude.translationZh: "我没想到会有99个人表示感谢。不知为何，这个结果让我惊喜不已，因为人们的反应远不止一句‘谢谢’。他们还会和我们聊上几句，"感恩职场(或译：感恩工作)首席执行官史蒂夫·福伦说道。
gratitude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

gratitude.sentenceEn: The family turned to social media expressing their gratitude saying, "From the bottom of our hearts, we would like to deeply thank each and every person that stopped by!"
gratitude.translationZh: 这家人通过社交媒体表达了他们的感激之情，他们说：“我们由衷地深深感谢每一位前来支持的人！”
gratitude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

gratitude.sentenceEn: Most people express gratitude for help.
gratitude.translationZh: 大多数人会对帮助表达感谢。

genuine.sentenceEn: However, they fail to provide a genuine education with an emphasis on convenience rather than critical thinking.
genuine.translationZh: 然而，这些课程未能提供真正的教育，它们强调的是便利性而非批判性思维。
genuine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

genuine.sentenceEn: Wouldn't it be nice if there was genuine , scientifically documented truth to the expression "what doesn't kill you makes you stronger"?
genuine.translationZh: 要是"那些没能击垮你的，终将使你更强大"这句俗语真有科学依据，那该多好啊！

genuine.sentenceEn: Genuine criticism creates a precious opening for an author to become better on his own terms—a process that is often extremely painful, but also almost always meaningful.
genuine.translationZh: 真正的批评为作者创造了宝贵的空间，让他们能够按照自己的方式变得更好——这个过程往往极其痛苦，但几乎总是富有意义。

genuine.sentenceEn: Genuine criticism, the type that leaves a lasting mark on you as a writer, also leaves an existential imprint(印记) on you as a person.
genuine.translationZh: 真正的批评，那种能在你作为作家的道路上留下永久印记的批评，也会在你作为人的存在层面留下深刻烙印。

genuine.sentenceEn: What does the author think constitutes a key part of genuine education?
genuine.translationZh: 作者认为构成真正教育的关键部分是什么？

genuine.sentenceEn: It may prevent people from developing a genuine sense of community.
genuine.translationZh: 这可能会阻碍人们建立真正的社群归属感。

grab.translationZh: 你是否曾将蛋白质饮料混合在一起作为早餐，或者在下午锻炼后拿起一条蛋白棒？
grab.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

grab.sentenceEn: Thus, he and his friends decided to grab a few trash bags and clean it all up.

grab.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

grab.sentenceEn: Nearly two-thirds of us grab fast food once a week, and we get almost 25% of our daily calories from snacks.
grab.translationZh: 近三分之二的美国人每周会吃一次快餐，而我们每天近25%的卡路里来自零食。

grab.translationZh: 天很热，于是你从当地小贩那里买了一瓶水。

grab.sentenceEn: I just jumped down and grabbed the baby.
grab.translationZh: 我当时就跳了下去，一把抓住了那个婴儿。

grateful.sentenceEn: I am so grateful to the team members who contributed through its nearly 25-year history.
grateful.translationZh: 我非常感激在公司近25年的历史中做出贡献的团队成员。
grateful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

grateful.sentenceEn: We are also grateful to our guests and partners who believed in our vision and encouraged us to push harder.
grateful.translationZh: 我们也衷心感谢各位合作伙伴与客户，感谢你们相信我们的愿景，并激励我们不断进取。

grateful.sentenceEn: Employee Eri Ito is grateful for their animals' comforting ways.
grateful.translationZh: 员工伊藤惠理（Eri Ito）对这些猫咪带来的慰藉心怀感激。
grateful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

grateful.sentenceEn: "What we know from research is that from grateful people come good things," he said.

grateful.sentenceEn: "We did have one that didn't say thank you. We're not here to judge them because on any given day, that could be me or you. I suspect out of the 100 people, there were probably a bunch of them having a bad day, but grateful people make people grateful ," said Foran.
grateful.translationZh: 福伦说：“确实有一个人没有说谢谢。但我们不是来评判他们的，因为在任何一天，那个人都可能是我，也可能是你。我猜想在这100个人中，或许有不少人那天过得不太顺心，但心怀感恩的人能让其他人也变得感恩。”

grateful.sentenceEn: People can be educated to be grateful .

greenhouse.sentenceEn: As well as greenhouse gases, rocket engines emit particles that destroy ozone.

greenhouse.sentenceEn: NASA used the term "climate change" because it more accurately reflects the wide range of changes to the planet caused by increasing amounts of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.

greenhouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

greenhouse.sentenceEn: Some argued that humans weren't producing enough greenhouse gases, while others claimed the effects would be tiny.
greenhouse.translationZh: 一些人认为人类产生的温室气体量不足，而另一些人则声称其影响微乎其微。

greenhouse.sentenceEn: It could add to greenhouse emissions.
